info.name: tuannt-api
info.description:
All endpoints of https://api.nttuan.dev (repo ngthotuan/tuannt-api).

**Setup:** fill the collection variables `username` / `password` (the admin account lives in `~/.env-dev` as ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD), then run **Auth → Login**. Its test script stores the JWT in `token`, and every request that needs it inherits Bearer auth from the collection. Public requests are set to *No Auth* on purpose: the API rejects an expired token even on public paths.

Switch `baseUrl` to `http://localhost:8089` for `./dev-run.sh`. Note that local and production share one database, so writes from either are real.

Errors always come back as `{ errorCode, errorMessage }`. Timestamps are epoch millis.

variable.description: ADMIN_PASSWORD from ~/.env-dev. Keep it out of shared/exported copies.
Set automatically by Auth → Login (current value only). Clear it before exporting or sharing the collection.
Set by Vocab (admin) → Add words. Requests that use it are skipped while it is empty, so they can never hit a real word by accident.
Password for Admin → Create user (8 or more characters, at most 72 bytes). Left empty on purpose.
Set by Blog (admin) → Create post. Requests that use it are skipped while it is empty.
Set by Projects (admin) → Create project. Requests that use it are skipped while it is empty.
Fill by hand with an id from Admin: contact inbox → List messages. Never set automatically: these are real visitor messages.
Set by Admin → Create user. Requests that use it are skipped while it is empty.
For Auth → Change own password. Left empty on purpose.
For Auth → Change own password (8 or more characters, at most 72 bytes). Left empty on purpose.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Accounts are created by an admin only; there is no sign-up. Tokens last 30 days.

request.description: Returns `{ token, expiresAt, user }` and stores the token in the `token` variable. Rate limited to 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP.
Current user from the token. 401 if the token is missing, invalid, expired, or its account was deleted.
Any logged-in user. 204; 401 `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` if `currentPassword` is wrong. Rate limited like login. Fill `currentPassword` / `newPassword` first; this changes the real account.

query.description: Case-insensitive search on en and vi

request.description: Newest first. Response: `{ items[{id,en,vi}], page, size, total, totalPages }`.
Server-picked random words. Response: `{ items, total }` where total is the pool size.
Words in list order (oldest first) from a zero-based offset. Empty items once offset passes the end.

item.description: ADMIN role only; a USER token gets 403. These change real data.

request.description: Batch of up to 500. Terms whose English already exists (case-insensitive) are skipped, not duplicated. Response: `{ created[], skipped[] }`. Stores the first created id in `wordId`. If the term already exists nothing is created and `wordId` is cleared, so Update/Save/Delete are skipped.

item.name: Admin
item.description: ADMIN role only. Guards: nobody can demote or delete themselves (400 `CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF`), and the last ADMIN can never be demoted or deleted (400 `LAST_ADMIN`). Existing tokens are not revoked by a demotion or deletion.

request.description: `[{ id, username, role, createdAt }]`, oldest first. Never includes password hashes.

username: 3-50 of letters, digits, `.` `_` `-`. password: 8-100 chars. role: USER (default) or ADMIN. 400 if the username exists. Creates a real account in the shared database. Fill `newUserPassword` first. Stores the new id in `userId`.

item.name: Blog (public)
item.description: No login needed. Only PUBLISHED posts are visible here.

request.description: Published posts, newest first, without `content`. Response: `{ items[summary], page, size, total, totalPages }`.
Tags of published posts with counts, most used first: `[{ tag, count }]`.

Full post incl. Markdown `content`. 404 `POST_NOT_FOUND` for a missing or unpublished slug. `{ id, slug, title, excerpt, content, coverUrl, tags[], status, publishedAt, createdAt, updatedAt }`; timestamps are epoch millis, publishedAt is null until first publish.

item.name: Blog (admin)
item.description: ADMIN role only. Changes that touch published content trigger the Pages deploy hook when one is configured. These change real data.

query.description: DRAFT or PUBLISHED; omit for all

request.description: Drafts included, most recently updated first, without `content`.
201 with the full post. Empty `slug` derives one from the title (Vietnamese diacritics stripped). 400 `SLUG_TAKEN` on a clash. Tags are normalised to kebab-case. Stores the id in `postId`.

  "slug": "",
  "title": "Bài viết thử từ Postman",
  "excerpt": "Short summary shown in lists",
  "content": "# Hello\n\nMarkdown body.",
  "coverUrl": "",
  "tags": [
    "Postman",
    "test"
  ],
  "status": "DRAFT"
}

item.name: Quiz history
item.description: Public, scoped by an anonymous deviceId.

request.description: Writes a real row. Only wrong answers are sent. Rate limited to 60/hour per IP.
`{ stats, attempts[], weakQuestions[] }` for the device.
Stores a real contact message (read it in the database; there is no notification). 201, no body. Rate limited to 5/hour per IP.
`{"status":"UP"}` when the app and its database are reachable.
Machine-readable spec; the Swagger UI is at {{baseUrl}}/docs.
